name: What are the benefits of converting my garage into a living space?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting my garage into a living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting your garage can significantly increase your usable living area without expanding your home's footprint. This adds value to your property and provides versatile space for a new bedroom, home office, gym, or rental unit. It's often a more cost-effective alternative to building a new addition and can improve energy efficiency if the garage was previously uninsulated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions expand your living space, add property value, and offer versatile new rooms like offices or bedrooms.
